title: Warmly Smoked Croatian Pork Belly Skillet
description: A traditional Croatian dish featuring pork belly slices, smoked to perfection in a tandoor and served in a cazuela, with a sweet and tangy flavor profile, this recipe is low in glycemic index and full of flavor.
instructions: Preheat the tandoor to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a small bowl, mix together the smoked paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and black pepper.
Rub the spice mixture all over the pork belly slices, making sure to coat them evenly.
Heat the olive oil in the cazuela over medium-high heat.
Add the pork belly slices to the cazuela and sear them for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until they are nicely browned.
Transfer the pork belly slices to the preheated tandoor and smoke for 10-12 minutes, or until they are cooked through.
While the pork is cooking, mix the apple cider vinegar and chopped fresh parsley in a small bowl.
Once the pork is done, remove it from the tandoor and brush it with the apple cider vinegar mixture.
Return the pork to the cazuela and simmer for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until the sauce has thickened slightly.
